## What it is

Parametric reconstruction of `Utility_Blade_Holder.STL`.

## Design notes

The selected B-Large grip changes only the free tip at x=0..9 mm: a 3 mm outer flat ledge at y=28..31 mm stays at z=5.5 mm, followed by a straight inward bevel to y=26 mm and z=4 mm. It stays inside the original rounded footprint and is an intentional deviation from the STL; the blade pocket and tongue are unchanged.

The 3.0 mm blade floor, overhanging 0.4 mm retaining lips, diagonal stop, and rounded triangular through-hole reproduce the functional blade channel rather than simplifying it to an open pocket.

The spring slot keeps the measured analytic U and tongue clearance. Its 0.5 mm default gap leaves a 3.25 mm tongue; changing `spring_gap` consumes tongue width from the fixed 3.75 mm envelope so the clearance stays uniform. Keep `spring_gap` above 0 and below 0.75 mm so the measured paired-radius cap remains connected.

`spring_slot_height` controls only the long straight cut after the U-shaped tongue region. Its lower edge stays at y=25.5 mm. At the left root, the existing fillet moves upward until its top is tangent to the slot, with a vertical wall returning to the tongue endpoint. The right end is one continuous semicircle with radius `spring_slot_height / 2` and its left tangent fixed at x=39.375 mm. The 2.0 mm default raises the cut to y=27.5 mm and produces an R1 end reaching x=40.375 mm; 2.8 mm produces an R1.4 end reaching x=40.775 mm. Increasing the height grows the cut only toward +Y. The maximum is 2.8 mm, while the minimum is the larger of 0.5 mm and `0.25 + spring_gap / 2` so the raised root fillet stays above the tongue endpoint. Release force, rail strength, and fatigue need verification on a printed part.

The rear thumb relief is a ruled loft through measured profiles at y=26 and y=31 because its blend radius changes across the part.

## Don't

Do not remove the blade-channel undercuts to silence the overhang check; they retain the blade and are present in the reference.

Do not widen the spring gap without checking grip and fatigue behavior.

Do not raise `spring_slot_height` above 2.8 mm without redesigning and testing the remaining outer rail.
